categories.title: 文字、按钮与输入框
categories.check: 检查文字截断、按钮内部异常换行、可读性和阅读文本块行长。

supporting_sources.S20: 复杂字形与 EditText 行高变化

categories.applies_when: 所有文字页面；45–75 字符规则核对阅读文本块和支持语言，不把短标题、金额或末行强行凑到 45 字符。
categories.required_evidence: 原文文本、支持语言、完整文本块和尺寸；实际计数，不能凭观感。
categories.do_not_report: 单行输入框随光标横向滚动正常；不因按钮或输入框全宽、填充/描边风格报错，不硬套 300dp 示例。

categories.title: 弹窗、菜单与底部面板

categories.title: 折叠、旋转与操作进度

core_dispositions.quote: State_Preservation T-State_Preservation , T-Back_Nav The app preserves user or app state when leaving the foreground and prevents accidental data loss due to back navigation and other state changes. When returning to the foreground, the app restores the preserved state and any pending stateful transactions. Examples include changes to editable fields, game progress, menus, videos, and other sections of the app. When the app is resumed from the Recents app switcher, the app returns the user to the exact state in which the app was last used. When the app is resumed after the device wakes from the sleep (locked) state, the app returns the user to the exact state in which the app was last used. When the app is relaunched from Home or All Apps , it should do one of the following, depending on how much time has passed since the app was last used: If the app was last used a short time ago (minutes), restore the app state as closely as possible to its previous state. If more time has passed since the app was last used, try to restore the app as closely as possible to its previous state or start the app from its home screen or some other default state.
core_dispositions.reason: 本次相关基本要求，按条件核对。

core_dispositions.quote: Notification_Quality T-Notification_Quality Notifications provide relevant information related to your app. Don't use notifications for cross-promotion or advertising of another product, as this is strictly prohibited by the Play Store. Notification channels are defined according to best practices, rather than serving all notifications from one channel. Select the correct notification priority . Stack multiple notifications into a single notification group when possible. Set timeouts for notifications where appropriate. Notifications are persistent only if related to ongoing events, such as music playback or a phone call. For more information, see the Functionality section .
